word-heat-weather.def: a period of very high temperatures outdoors

word-frost.def: a thin white layer of ice on surfaces when the temperature drops below zero

word-hail.def: small hard balls of ice that fall from clouds like rain

word-humidity.def: the amount of water vapor in the air

word-drought.def: a long time with little or no rain

word-weather-forecast.def: a report that says what the sky and temperature will be like in the coming days

word-shade.def: a cool, darker place out of direct sunlight

word-snowfall.def: the falling of white ice flakes from the sky, or the amount that falls

word-mist.def: a thin cloud of tiny water drops near the ground that makes it hard to see far

word-puddle.def: a small amount of water lying on the ground after rain

word-bush.def: a low plant with many woody stems, smaller than a tree

word-pine.def: a tall evergreen tree with long thin needles and cones

word-oak.def: a large tree with hard wood that grows acorns

word-birch.def: a slim tree with thin white or silvery bark

word-palm-tree.def: a tropical plant with a tall bare trunk and big leaves at the top

word-tulip.def: a spring flower shaped like a cup, grown from a bulb

word-sunflower.def: a tall plant with a big round yellow head full of edible seeds

word-cactus.def: a desert plant with thick green stems and sharp spines

word-moss.def: a soft green plant that grows in thick patches on damp ground, rocks or trees

word-meadow.def: a field covered with grass and wild flowers

word-swamp.def: wet land covered with shallow water, where trees and plants grow

word-volcano.def: a mountain with an opening where hot melted rock and gas can burst out

word-glacier.def: a huge, slow-moving mass of ice in a cold valley or mountain area

word-peak.def: the pointed top of a mountain

word-rock.def: a large piece of hard stone, or the hard material that makes up mountains

word-cliff.def: a high, steep wall of rock, often at the edge of the sea

word-bay.def: a wide curve of coast where the sea reaches into the land

word-shore.def: the land along the edge of the sea or a lake

word-stream.def: a narrow body of water that flows along the ground, smaller than a river

word-pond.def: a small area of still water, smaller than a lake

word-landscape.def: everything you can see across an area of land, such as hills, fields and trees

word-horizon.def: the faraway line where the earth or sea seems to touch the sky

word-soil.def: the top layer of the ground where plants grow

word-national-park.def: a large area of land that the government protects for its beauty and wildlife

word-nature-reserve.def: an area where wild animals and plants are kept safe from harm

word-environment-protection.def: actions that keep air, water and land clean and safe from damage

word-climate-change.def: the long-term rise in Earth's temperature and shift in weather patterns

word-renewable-energy.def: power from sources that do not run out, such as the sun and wind

word-allemansratten.gl: allemansrätten: Swedish public right to roam, camp and pick berries on most land

word-machair.gl: machair: fertile low coastal grassland on shell sand, typical of the Hebrides
